verdict.rationale: The pack shows official iOS SDKs for specific cardholder-facing tasks (reveal card details, change PIN) and an Authentication SDK for OOB 3D Secure, plus an llms.txt endpoint suggesting AI-friendly docs, but there is no evidence of broader official SDKs (e.g., server-side language SDKs) for the core Issuing API, and probes show no OpenAPI spec discoverable. missing for 10: multi-language server SDK documentation, OpenAPI/spec-based SDK generation evidence, independent confirmation of SDK quality/coverage.
